title: prediction calibration: a prediction that names value, tolerance and reference class is hit at least 70 % of the time (loop 18 prose predictions: 7 of 12)

a.recipe: predictions of cycle 19 and the first loop after it, written as {value, tol, class} where tol = max(2 x measured seed SD of E240, 0.005) and value is the median of the reference class (below) shrunk by half towards zero unless the card names a structural mechanism; scored by experiments/E242_prediction-calibration/rescore.py (CPU) from decision.json files; needs at least 8 numeric predictions
a.note: scored forward; the retrospective part (arm c, 5 numeric effect predictions with decision.json + 7 prose hits of loop 18) is computed now

c.recipe: loop 18 as recorded: 5 numeric effect predictions in decision.json files (E215 +0.140, E219 +0.010 / +0.003 / +0.008, E232 +0.030), mean absolute error 0.0145 in metrics.py (it is the mean over exactly these five; the 7 of 12 hit count is a separate prose count)
c.note: reference value 0.0145 from `metrics.py`; the signed errors are +0.0044, -0.0023, -0.0071, -0.0043, -0.0543 (decision.json files)

rule.note: cycle-19+ mean absolute error at least 0.005 below 0.0145, i.e. <= 0.0095
hit rate inside the written tolerance at least 0.10 above the prose rate 7 / 12 = 0.58, i.e. >= 0.68; the metric is counted by rescore.py, not by the words 'met' / 'missed'

kill: if fewer than 8 numeric predictions exist after two loops, report the retrospective table only and stop; if the written tolerances are all copied from the band (tol = band) the experiment is void
